limits: Separate instrumented pages/scopes are not clean performance.
Cold counters include initialization plus1s, not only asset upload.
CPU scope samples are lastMs snapshots, not complete per-invocation distributions; parent/child scopes overlap.
GPU pass timestamps and GL application-command interval differ; neither is compositor latency.

cpuScopeEvidence.method: changed reported CPU histories relative to the measurement boundary
cpuScopeEvidence.limitation: Identically remeasured and untouched histories are indistinguishable; intermediate invocations are not recovered. These are sparse observed last-sample changes, not per-frame scope histograms.

work.boundary: immediately before activation and after deactivation of measured RAF window
work.scope: glTF counters only; not whole-renderer allocation totals
